definitions.explanation: An item or offer that provides good value for the price.

examples.japanese: これはお{買|か}い{得|どく}だ。
お{買|か}い{得|どく}{品|ひん}を{探|さが}す。
{三|みっ}つ{買|か}うと{一|ひと}つ{無料|むりょう}でお{買|か}い{得|どく}です。
examples.english: Buy three get one free is a good deal.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{買|か}い{得|どく}{品|ひん}: bargain item
- お{買|か}い{得|どく}{価格|かかく}: bargain price
- お{買|か}い{得|どく}セット: value set

USAGE NOTE:
Often used in advertising and on sale signs. The お prefix adds a sense of attractiveness to the deal.

RELATED:
- {割引|わりびき}: discount
- セール: sale
- {特売|とくばい}: special sale
